name: UX & Interaction Principles
description: UX & Interaction Principles standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-UX applies.

rules.title: Design around user goals and complete task flows
rules.detail: Each feature defines primary users, entry points, goal, success outcome and important alternate/failure paths before detailed UI implementation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design around user goals and complete task flows.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design around user goals and complete task flows.

rules.title: Preserve consistency with established interaction patterns
rules.detail: Navigation, actions, terminology and control behavior should reuse platform/design-system conventions unless research or requirements justify a deviation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Preserve consistency with established interaction patterns.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Preserve consistency with established interaction patterns.

rules.title: Minimize irreversible actions and surprise
rules.detail: Destructive or high-impact actions require clear consequence, appropriate confirmation and recovery/undo where feasible.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Minimize irreversible actions and surprise.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Minimize irreversible actions and surprise.

rules.title: Keep system status visible
rules.detail: Users should understand loading, progress, completion, offline/degraded state and errors without guessing whether an action occurred.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep system status visible.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep system status visible.

rules.title: Reduce cognitive load
rules.detail: Prioritize primary actions, progressively disclose complexity and avoid presenting unnecessary choices or technical implementation detail.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Reduce cognitive load.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Reduce cognitive load.

rules.title: Validate critical journeys with representative users or evidence
rules.detail: High-impact flows should be reviewed against usability, accessibility and real content/device constraints before release.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate critical journeys with representative users or evidence.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate critical journeys with representative users or evidence.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-UX applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of UX & Interaction Principles to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: UX & Interaction Principles is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses UX & Interaction Principles failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
